content.text:
The site's custom font wasn't loading. That's why every page looked different: they all fell back to the browser's default system font.

**Cause:** `site/css/tokens.css` loads "Acme Sans" from `../font/acme-sans.woff2`, but the folder is `site/fonts/` (plural). The font file returned a 404, so all text switched to `system-ui`, which changed the look, spacing and weights everywhere. All six pages share `tokens.css`, which is why the whole site was affected at once.

**Fix:** I changed one line in `site/css/tokens.css:5` to `url('../fonts/acme-sans.woff2')`.

**Checks:**
- In a headless browser, the font now loads on all six pages, with no 404s or console errors.
- I scanned every `url()`, `href` and `src` in the CSS and HTML, and this was the only broken reference. All the stylesheets also parse cleanly.
- The functional tests pass (16 of 16).

The repo has only its initial commit, so I couldn't look at the history to see exactly which change introduced the bad path. The edit isn't committed yet.

STATUS: DONE
